fields.name_zh:
婚姻歷史
A17.現在，我想請教你的婚姻現況：你結過婚嗎﹖你的丈夫(太太)和你在一起嗎﹖或是你們暫時不住在一起﹖或長久分居了﹖還是離婚、喪偶﹖或你不曾結婚﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
Marital history
A17. Now, I would like to ask about your current marital status: Have you ever been married? Are you currently living with your husband (wife)? Or are you temporarily living apart? Or have you been separated for a long time? Or are you divorced, widowed? Or have you never married?

fields.name_zh: A17a.目前你生活中有沒有老伴?
fields.name_zh_en: A17a. Do you currently have a companion (spouse/partner) in your life?

fields.name_zh: A18.請問你為什麼一直沒有結婚?
fields.name_zh_en: A18. Why have you never gotten married?

fields.name_zh: A19.有些人有結婚一次以上的經驗，請問你有沒有過這種情形?
fields.name_zh_en: A19. Some people have been married more than once. Have you had this experience?

fields.name_zh: A19a.你總共結婚過幾?_____次
fields.name_zh_en: A19a. How many times in total have you been married? _____ times

fields.name_zh:
A20.請問你是在幾歲或是什麼時候結婚的﹖
_____歲時；或：民國______年______月【換算實足年齡後填入年齡欄】
fields.name_zh_en:
A20. At what age or when did you get married?
At age _____; or: ROC year ______ month ______ [Convert to actual age and enter in the age field]

fields.name_zh:
A21.【所有都問】請問你先生(或太太)是什麼時候出生的﹖
〔如不知出生年〕他(她)今年幾足歲﹖_____歲
〔如仍不知歲數〕他(她)的生肖是_____【調查員：請估算其年齡約_____歲】
fields.name_zh_en:
A21. [Ask everyone] When was your husband (or wife) born?
[If birth year unknown] How old is he (she) this year (full age)? _____ years old
[If age still unknown] What is his (her) zodiac animal? _____ [Interviewer: please estimate his/her age at approximately _____ years old]

fields.name_zh:
_____年

_____ (month)

fields.name_zh_en: A22. [Ask everyone] What is the highest level of education your husband (or wife) completed?

fields.name_zh:

fields.name_zh_en:

Why is your husband (or wife) currently not living here? _____

fields.name_zh_en: A27d. Did that marriage end because of the husband's (or wife's) death, or because of divorce?

fields.name_zh_en: A28. Who decided on your (first) marriage?

fields.name_zh: A28a.你們(第一次)結婚的時侯，是夫妻單獨住﹖與父母(或公婆)同住﹖或與其他親戚同住﹖
fields.name_zh_en: A28a. When you (first) got married, did you and your spouse live alone? Live with parents (or parents-in-law)? Or live with other relatives?

fields.name_zh: A28b.你們是否和他們一起住到他們死亡為止﹖
fields.name_zh_en: A28b. Did you live with them until they passed away?

fields.name_zh:
你們婚後一共和他們同住了幾年﹖
約_____年
fields.name_zh_en:
In total, how many years did you live with them after marriage?
Approx. _____ years

fields.name_zh_en: A28c. Why did you stop living with them at that time?

fields.name_zh: A28d.你們結婚時為什麼沒有與父母(或公婆)住﹖
fields.name_zh_en: A28d. Why didn't you live with your parents (or parents-in-law) when you got married?

fields.name_zh: A29.請問你們結婚(如有結婚二次以上者指最後一次婚姻)的時候，你先生(或太太)的職業是什麼﹖_____
fields.name_zh_en: A29. When you got married (for those married more than once, refers to the most recent marriage), what was your husband's (or wife's) occupation? _____

fields.name_zh: A29a.這項工作是他(她)一生中最常從事的工作嗎?
fields.name_zh_en: A29a. Is this the job he (she) held most often throughout his/her life?

fields.name_zh: A29b.他(她)後來沒再工作(一生都沒工作(或在家裡))嗎?
fields.name_zh_en: A29b. Did he (she) never work again afterward (never worked in his/her life, or stayed home)?

fields.name_zh: A29c.那麼他(她)最主要的工作是什麼_____
fields.name_zh_en: A29c. So what was his (her) main occupation? _____

fields.name_zh: A29d.他(她)現在還在工作嗎?
fields.name_zh_en: A29d. Is he (she) still working now?

fields.name_zh_en: A30. [If employed, ask:] How many more years do you think he (she) can continue working?_____ years

fields.name_zh: A30a.那是看什麼情形?_____
fields.name_zh_en: A30a. What did it depend on?_____

fields.name_zh: A30b.【如果退休，問】請問他(她)退休多久了?_____年
fields.name_zh_en: A30b. [If retired, ask] How long has he (she) been retired?_____ years

Ｈ.關心與照顧
H1.首先想請問你，當你需要和人談談你的問題或你的心事時，你覺得他們願不願意聽你講﹖
a.當你需要和人談你的問題或你的心事時，你覺得你先生/太太願不願意聽你講﹖是非常願意、很願意、願意、不太願意，還是非常不願意﹖
fields.name_zh_en: H. Care and concern H1. First, I would like to ask: when you need to talk to someone about your problems or concerns, do you feel they are willing to listen? a. When you need to talk to your husband/wife about your problems or concerns, do you feel he/she is willing to listen? Very willing, quite willing, willing, not very willing, or very unwilling?

fields.name_zh: b.你覺得你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子願不願意聽你講﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do you feel your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren are willing to listen to you?

fields.name_zh: c.你覺得你的朋友、鄰居和親戚願不願意聽你講﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do you feel your friends, neighbors, and relatives are willing to listen to you?

fields.name_zh:
d.【如果有人願意聽個案講心事】是誰最願意聽你講心事呢﹖其次是誰﹖
最願意聽_____
fields.name_zh_en:
d. [If there is someone willing to listen to your worries] Who is most willing to listen? Who is next?
Most willing to listen: _____

fields.name_zh: 次願意聽_____
fields.name_zh_en: Times willing to listen _____

fields.name_zh:
H2.下面我們想知道，你覺得你身旁的人是不是關心你﹖
a.你覺得你先生/太太是不是關心你﹖是非常關心、很關心、關心、不太關心，還是非常不關心﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H2. Next we would like to know whether you feel the people around you care about you.
a. Do you feel your spouse cares about you? Very caring, quite caring, caring, not very caring, or not caring at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你覺得你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子是不是關心你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do you feel your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren care about you?

fields.name_zh: c.你覺得你的朋友、鄰居或親戚是不是關心你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do you feel your friends, neighbors, or relatives care about you?

fields.name_zh:
H3.這些人對你的關心和照顧，你覺得滿不滿足﹖
a.你先生/太太對你的關心和照顧，你覺得滿不滿足﹖是很滿足、滿足，還是不滿足﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H3. Are you satisfied with the care and concern these people show you?
a. Are you satisfied with the care and concern your spouse shows you? Very satisfied, satisfied, or not satisfied?

fields.name_zh: b.你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子對你的關心和照顧，你覺得滿不滿足﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Are you satisfied with the concern and care your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren show you?

fields.name_zh: c.你朋友、鄰居或親戚對你的關心和照顧，你覺得滿不滿足﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Are you satisfied with the concern and care your friends, neighbors, or relatives show you?

fields.name_zh:
H4.當你生病時，你是不是可以依賴你身邊的人﹖
a.當你生病時，你是不是可以依賴你先生/太太﹖是非常可依賴、很可依賴、可依賴、有點可依賴，還是完全不可依賴﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H4. When you are sick, can you rely on the people around you?
a. When you are sick, can you rely on your spouse? Very reliable, quite reliable, reliable, somewhat reliable, or not reliable at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你是不是可以依賴你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Can you rely on your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren?

fields.name_zh: c.你是不是可以依賴你朋友、鄰居或親戚﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Can you rely on your friends, neighbors, or relatives?

fields.name_zh:
d.【如果有人是生病時可以依賴的】是誰最可以依賴呢﹖其次是誰﹖
最可依賴_____
fields.name_zh_en:
d. [If there is someone you can rely on when sick] Who can you rely on most? Who is next?
Most reliable: _____

fields.name_zh: 次可依賴_____
fields.name_zh_en: Times can rely on _____

fields.name_zh: e.在過去一年當中，當你生病時你身邊的人是不是有照顧你﹖這些人是一直照顧你嗎﹖還是大部份時候、有時候、很少或從未照顧你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: e. In the past year, when you were sick, did the people around you take care of you? Did they always take care of you, or most of the time, sometimes, rarely, or never?

fields.name_zh:
H5.你是不是可以依靠你身邊的人幫你應付你的開支﹖
a.你是不是可以靠你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子幫你應付你的開支﹖是非常可依靠、很可依靠、可依靠、有點可依靠，還是完全不可依靠﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H5. Can you rely on the people around you to help cover your expenses?
a. Can you rely on your children, daughter-in-law, son-in-law, or grandchildren to help cover your expenses? Very reliable, quite reliable, reliable, somewhat reliable, or not reliable at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你是不是可以依靠你朋友、鄰居或親戚幫你應付你的開支﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Can you rely on your friends, neighbors, or relatives to help cover your expenses?

fields.name_zh: c.在過去一年裡，當你需要經濟(金錢)支援時這些人會不會幫助你﹖這些人總是幫助你嗎﹖還是大部份時候、有時候、很少或從未幫助你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. In the past year, when you needed financial support, did these people help you? Did they always help you, or most of the time, sometimes, rarely, or never?

fields.name_zh:
H6.你身邊這些人在你生病時給你的照顧和經濟(金錢)支援，你覺得滿不滿意﹖
a.你先生/太太在你生病時給你的照顧和經濟(金錢)支援，你覺得滿不滿意﹖是非常滿意、很滿意、滿意、不太滿意，還是非常不滿意﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H6. Are you satisfied with the care and financial (monetary) support given to you by the people around you when you are sick?
a. Are you satisfied with the care and financial (monetary) support given to you by your husband/wife when you are sick? Very satisfied, quite satisfied, satisfied, not very satisfied, or very dissatisfied?

fields.name_zh: b.你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子在你生病時給你的照顧和經濟(金錢)支援，你覺得滿不滿意﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Are you satisfied with the care and financial (monetary) support your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren give you when you are sick?

fields.name_zh: c.你朋友、鄰居或親戚在你生病時給你的照顧和經濟(金錢)支援，你覺得滿不滿意﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Are you satisfied with the care and financial support your friends, neighbors, or relatives give you when you are sick?

fields.name_zh:
H7.你覺得你身邊的人對你要求過份嗎﹖
a.你覺得你先生/太太對你的要求會不會過份﹖是非常過份、很過份、有點過份、不過份，還是完全不過份﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H7. Do you feel the people around you make excessive demands on you?
a. Do you feel your spouse's demands on you are excessive? Very excessive, quite excessive, somewhat excessive, not excessive, or not excessive at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你覺得你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子對你的要求會不會過份﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do you feel your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren make excessive demands on you?

fields.name_zh: c.你覺得你的朋友、鄰居或親戚對你的要求會不會過份﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do you feel your friends, neighbors, or relatives make excessive demands on you?

fields.name_zh:
H8.你覺得你身邊的人對你或你的所作所為會不會有批評﹖
a.你覺得你先生/太太對你或你的所作所為會不會有批評﹖是非常多、很多、有一些、不太多，還是完全沒有﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H8. Do you feel the people around you criticize you or what you do?
a. Do you feel your spouse criticizes you or what you do? Very much, a lot, somewhat, not very much, or not at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你覺得你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子對你或你的所作所為會不會有批評﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do you feel your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren criticize you or what you do?

fields.name_zh: c.你覺得你的朋友、鄰居或親戚對你或你的所作所為會不會有批評﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do you feel your friends, neighbors, or relatives criticize you or what you do?

fields.name_zh:
H9.你覺得你身邊的人是不是過份保護你?
a.你覺得你先生/太太是不是過份保護你﹖是非常過份、很過份、有點過份、不太過份，還是完全不過份﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H9. Do you feel the people around you are overprotective of you?
a. Do you feel your spouse is overprotective of you? Very overprotective, quite overprotective, somewhat overprotective, not very overprotective, or not at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你覺得你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子是不是過份保護你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do you feel your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren are overprotective of you?

fields.name_zh: c.你覺得你的朋友、鄰居或親戚是不是過份保護你﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do you feel your friends, neighbors, or relatives are overprotective of you?

fields.name_zh:
H10.你身邊的人會不會帶給你經濟負擔?
a.你先生/太太會不會帶給你經濟負擔﹖是非常重、很重、有一些、不太重，還是完全沒有負擔﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H10. Do the people around you bring you financial burden?
a. Does your husband/wife bring you financial burden? Is it very heavy, quite heavy, somewhat, not very heavy, or no burden at all?

fields.name_zh: b.你孩子、媳婦、女婿或孫子會不會帶給你經濟負擔﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. Do your children, daughters/sons-in-law, or grandchildren impose a financial burden on you?

fields.name_zh: c.你的朋友、鄰居或親戚會不會帶給你經濟負擔﹖
fields.name_zh_en: c. Do your friends, neighbors, or relatives place a financial burden on you?

fields.name_zh:
H11.現在，我想請問你一些關於你為家人、朋友或鄰居所做的事。
a.當你的家人想要談他們的憂慮或問題時，你會不會聽他們談﹖你總是會聽他們談嗎﹖還是大部份時候、有時候、很少或從未聽過﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H11. Now I would like to ask you some questions about things you do for your family, friends, or neighbors.
a. When your family wants to talk about their worries or problems, do you listen to them? Do you always listen to them? Or most of the time, sometimes, rarely, or never?

fields.name_zh:
b.當你的朋友、鄰居或親戚想要談他們的憂慮或問題時，你會不會聽他
們談﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. When your friends, neighbors, or relatives want to talk about their worries or problems, do you listen to them?

fields.name_zh:
H12.
a.當你的家人覺得難過的時候，你會不會安慰或鼓勵他們﹖你總是會安慰他們嗎﹖還是大部份時候、有時候、很少或從未安慰過﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H12.
a. When your family feels sad, do you comfort or encourage them? Do you always comfort them? Or most of the time, sometimes, rarely, or never?

fields.name_zh: b.當你的朋友、鄰居或親戚覺得難過的時候，你會不會安慰或鼓勵他們﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. When your friends, neighbors, or relatives feel sad, do you comfort or encourage them?

fields.name_zh:
H13.
a.在金錢和物質的方面，你認為自己對家庭的幫助有多少呢﹖是非常多、很多、有一點、很少，還是一點都沒有﹖
fields.name_zh_en:
H13.
a. In terms of money and material support, how much help do you think you provide to your family? A great deal, a lot, a little, very little, or none at all?

fields.name_zh: b.在這方面你認為自己對朋友、鄰居或親戚的幫助有多少呢﹖
fields.name_zh_en: b. In this respect, how much help do you think you give to your friends, neighbors, or relatives?
